title: EgressRule
description: A single domain allowlist rule with optional header injection.

credential.description: Optional. Reference to a server-managed Credential resource by ID.

domain.description: Domain to allow outbound requests to. Supports wildcards (e.g. '*.googleapis.com'). Use '*' to allow all domains.

mode.description: Network egress mode. Set via the `"allowlist": "disabled"` short form; must be the only rule in the allowlist and cannot be combined with `domain`, `transform` or `credential`.

transform.description: Headers to inject into requests matching this rule. Key: header name (e.g., "Authorization"). Value: header value (e.g., "Bearer your-token").
